# 👻 Solo/Co-op Exploration in Haunted Mansion
Horror Simulator is a heart-pounding interactive story & horror adventure for both singleplayer and 3 player co-op. Demons are said to lurk within the mansion, terrorizing countless victims. Legends suggest knowing a demon's true name grants control over it. Now, brave souls like you must form a team of exorcists, delve deep into the mansion to uncover the demon's name, capture and vanquish it for rich rewards. 
{2122697684780894}

# 🕸 Immersive Gameplay
Hunt various demons representing the seven deadly sins.

Use 7 sacramental items as evidence to solve puzzles and reveal each sin.

Play solo or 3-player co-op with real-time voice chat for seamless social experience. 
{391738560189539}

# 😱 Survive or Die Trying
Demons will do everything to scare you off, or even kill you. Once your sanity runs out, demons will initiate hunt mode. Find out the demon's name before your sanity is drained. 

Real-time voice chat lets you strategize and improve your chances of success—while you're still alive. In ghost mode, you can use items to guide teammates. 


# 🙀 Shop System
Complete your tasks in each run to earn coins and buy skins and items in the store. Customize your Exorcist avatar, but be warned -- just because you look cool doesn't mean the demons will let you off easy.


Dare to venture forth?
